subject: Stepdown credit ladder & staggered VAT reflow proposal
messages:
From: Evan Ward <evan.ward@aureonhealth.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Sana Desai <sana.desai@aureonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary net60 + VAT reflow while entity migration completes

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team is excited to get Redwood into a production pilot. We have a short window on our side: the EU entity migration (UK -> IE) finishes mid-September which affects our VAT registration and invoices.

To avoid interrupting usage, finance has asked whether Aureon can be set up on a temporary net60 payment cadence for the next 90 days, with a staged (stepdown) credit ceiling tied to monthly consumption. Also, because of entity reflow timing, we need Redwood to invoice without local VAT for invoices dated before the new IE VAT registration is live, and then reflow VAT when the registration is complete.

Key asks:
- Net60 for 90 days starting Sept 1, review on Dec 1.
- A credit ladder: initial €250k ceiling, stepdown to €150k after month 2 unless usage commitments met.
- Redwood to issue tax-free invoices pre-registration, then issue VAT adjustment invoices or credit memos post-registration.

Can you confirm if Redwood supports staged credit and post hoc VAT reflows? If so, please propose an operational plan and any paperwork we need to sign.

Attached: Aureon forecast and entity migration timeline (PDF).

Best,
Evan
Head of Finance, Aureon Health

Attachments: Aureon_forecast_aug2026.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Evan Ward <evan.ward@aureonhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary net60 + VAT reflow while entity migration completes

Evan —

Appreciate the context and the forecast — this is doable, we just need to align operationally on a couple of points. High level: Redwood can enable a temporary Net60 window alongside a tiered credit ceiling and support post-registration VAT reflows via credit memos + corrected invoices.

Outline of our proposed approach:
1) Stepdown credit ladder:
   - Day 0 (Sept 1): provisional credit ceiling €250,000;
   - After 60 days: conditional review; if consumption < committed ramp, automatically stepdown to €150,000;
   - Finance triggers: automatic email alerts at 75% and 95% of ceiling; manual override possible by written confirmation from Aureon's finance lead.
2) Payment cadence: Net60 for invoices issued between Sept 1 – Nov 30. Invoices dated Dec 1 onward revert to standard Net30 unless we agree extension.
3) VAT reflow: Redwood issues pre-registration invoices with zero VAT (supplier invoice), then once IE registration is active we issue VAT adjustment credit memos and corrected invoices. We can accommodate either: (A) vendor-side credit + new invoice or (B) a single consolidated VAT adjustment at registration date — Aureon preference?
4) Audit trail & controls: we will attach a VAT adjustment reference on every corrected invoice, maintain audit logs in the Console, and provide a csv of corrected invoice pairs for your tax agent.
5) Paperwork: a short amendment to the Master Services Agreement + a separate credit annex describing ladder triggers and automatic stepdown rules.

Next steps from Redwood: Laura will draft the amendment and credit annex. Marcus will confirm the automated alert thresholds and escalations for overrides. We aim to have the amendment in your hands by Friday Aug 28.

If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute call to walk finance/legal teams through the amendment flow and the VAT adjustment examples.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

--
Olga Petrov
Redwood Inference | olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Evan / Sana —

Following Olga's note, attached is the draft amendment to your Master Services Agreement and the standalone credit annex (Aureon_Stepdown_Proposal_v1.pdf). Highlights:
- Effective period: 2026-09-01 through 2026-11-30 (Net60 window).
- Credit ceiling: €250,000 initially; automatic stepdown to €150,000 on 2026-10-31 unless consumption threshold of €1.2M ARR-equivalent is reached.
- VAT adjustment options: (1) per-invoice credit memos + corrected invoices; or (2) single consolidated VAT adjustment invoice at registration date. We note financial accounting prefers option (1) for month-by-month reconciliations.
- Audit deliverables: monthly corrected-invoice csv, consolidated VAT report, Console export access for 90 days post-adjustment.

Please review sections 3.1 (credit triggers) and 4.2 (VAT flow). We flagged a few operational notes where we need Aureon's sign-off (marked in yellow in the PDF).

If these terms look ok, I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope for the amendment and the annex. If you need changes to the stepdown date or the consumption threshold, tell us and we'll iterate.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Laura / Olga —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the PDF with our tax agent. A couple of notes:
- We prefer per-invoice credit memos + corrected invoices (option 1). That aligns best with our month-end close.
- Can the initial ceiling be split into a €200k immediate facility + a €50k contingent buffer that requires written approval to pull? That helps our treasury team manage exposure.
- We can accept the automatic stepdown date of Oct 31, but request an earlier notification cadence (email at 60/30/14/3 days prior to stepdown).

Sana will push the signed DocuSign back by EOD tomorrow once the amendment reflects the buffer split and the notification cadence. Marcus — shout if you need anything specific from our accounting system for the Console exports.

Appreciate the operational clarity — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you prefer to finalize.

Best,
Evan
